elements.description:
A recording with a transcript that follows playback: timestamps, speakers, recognition and translation confidence,
low-confidence segments marked, search, and "Send to verification".

properties.name: segments
properties.description: The transcript, in order of `start`

properties.name: speakers
properties.description: Names, chip text and colours for the speaker ids in `segments`; an id with no entry shows as itself

properties.name: src
properties.description: The recording's URL; the element makes its own <audio> or <video> (see `kind`). Ignored when `media` is set

properties.name: media
properties.description: The app's own <audio> or <video> to drive instead of `src`. A <video> that isn't on the page is shown in the card

properties.name: kind
properties.description: What `src` is: "audio" (default) or "video", which shows the picture above the waveform

properties.name: peaks
properties.description: The waveform: loudness peaks from 0 to 1, as many as you have – they're resampled to fit the width

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The recording's length in seconds, until the media reports it (default: the last segment's end)

properties.name: threshold
properties.description: Segments and words with confidence below this (0–1) are marked for checking

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: description
properties.description: The quiet line under the heading (default: the length and how many speakers)

properties.name: translationMode
properties.description: What the transcript shows when segments have translations: the original, the translation, or both side by side

properties.name: originalLabel
properties.description: The name of the original language's column and button, e.g. "Spanish"

properties.name: translationLabel
properties.description: The name of the translation's column and button, e.g. "English (machine)"

properties.name: hiddenSpeakers
properties.description: Speaker ids whose segments the list leaves out

properties.name: query
properties.description: The search text

properties.name: sent
properties.description: Ids of segments already sent to verification

properties.name: verifiable
properties.description: Shows "Send to verification" on each segment (default true)

properties.name: verifyLabel
properties.description: The verification action's label

properties.name: skip
properties.description: How far J and L (and the back and forward buttons) jump, in seconds

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: The tallest the list grows, in px, before it scrolls

properties.name: totalDuration
properties.description: The recording's length in seconds: `duration`, else what the media reports, else the last segment's end

properties.name: currentSegment
properties.description: The segment being played, if any

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-segment-change
events.description: The segment being played changed (playback, a seek or a step); detail `{ segment }` (TranscriptSegmentChange) – null in a gap between segments

events.name: tc-verify
events.description: "Send to verification" on a segment; detail `{ segment, sent }` (TranscriptVerifyDetail) – `sent` is the list after it. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps `sent` as it is

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: Copy on a segment; detail `{ segment, text }` (TranscriptCopyDetail) – the text with its timestamp and speaker. Cancelable: preventDefault() and copy it yourself

events.name: tc-query-change
events.description: The search text changed; detail `{ query }` (TranscriptQueryChange). Cancelable

events.name: tc-hidden-speakers-change
events.description: A speaker chip was toggled; detail `{ hiddenSpeakers }` (TranscriptHiddenSpeakersChange). Cancelable

events.name: tc-translation-mode-change
events.description: Original, Translation or Side by side was chosen; detail `{ mode }` (TranscriptTranslationModeChange). Cancelable

methods.name: play
methods.description: Plays the media from where it is

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves playback to `seconds` from the start

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name

props.name: query
props.description: The search text – controlled when defined; pair it with `onQueryChange`

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: The search text at first, when `query` isn't controlled

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Called as the search text changes

props.name: hiddenSpeakers
props.description: Speaker ids the list leaves out – controlled when defined

props.name: defaultHiddenSpeakers
props.description: Speaker ids left out at first, when `hiddenSpeakers` isn't controlled

props.name: onHiddenSpeakersChange
props.description: Called when a speaker chip is toggled, with the ids now hidden

props.name: translationMode
props.description: Original, translation or both side by side – controlled when defined

props.name: defaultTranslationMode
props.description: The view at first, when `translationMode` isn't controlled (default "original")

props.name: onTranslationModeChange
props.description: Called when the view is switched

props.name: sent
props.description: Ids of segments sent to verification – controlled when defined; pair it with `onSentChange`

props.name: defaultSent
props.description: Ids already sent at first, when `sent` isn't controlled

props.name: onSentChange
props.description: Called with every sent id after "Send to verification"

props.name: onVerify
props.description: Called when a segment is sent to verification – hand it to your review process here

props.name: onCopySegment
props.description: Called when a segment is copied, with the text that went to the clipboard

props.name: onSegmentChange
props.description: Called when the segment being played changes – null in a gap between segments

changelog: **Trust & calibration**, from THEMIS and built domain-neutral: - `tc-agreement-tracker`, `tc-confidence-brief`, `tc-capability-notice`, `tc-transcript-review`, `tc-version-history`, `tc-session-context-bar`, `tc-evidence-coverage`, `tc-review-conflict`; - `tc-handoff-brief`, `tc-engagement-quality`, `tc-knowledge-promotion`, `tc-friction-profile`, `tc-reasoning-flags`.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-color
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default colours.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
